**Is your feature request related to a problem? Please describe.**
A clear and concise description of what the problem or limitation is.

**Describe the proposed solution**
A clear and concise description of the computer vision algorithm or architectural feature you want to add.

**Theoretical Foundation (Digital Image Processing 4E)**
Reference to relevant book chapter/equations if applicable (e.g. Chapter 9 Morphology, Chapter 11 Descriptors).

**Real-Time Latency Impact**
Estimated computation time per frame. Will this maintain the $\le 16.66\text{ ms}$ ($60\text{ FPS}$) budget?

**Additional context**
Add any other context, mockup screenshots, or diagrams here.
